root_cause.text: A copy-paste error caused the UAC3 AC header descriptor validator to incorrectly use UAC_VERSION_2 instead of UAC_VERSION_3, so UAC3 devices bypass header validation, enabling out-of-bounds reads from a truncated descriptor.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the entry in `audio_validators[]` from `FIXED(UAC_VERSION_2, UAC_HEADER, struct uac3_ac_header_descriptor)` to `FIXED(UAC_VERSION_3, UAC_HEADER, struct uac3_ac_header_descriptor)`. The CVE description confirms this mismatch means the validator never runs for UAC3 devices, allowing malicious USB devices with truncated headers to cause out-of-bounds reads.
